positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Developer at Blizzard Entertainment, I led the design and implementation of a modular monolith, standardizing technology and contracts to enhance functionality and support for the OpsCenter. I also drove the modernization of legacy projects, integrating them into a modern tech stack and modularizing business and technical operations into NuGet packages.

Key responsibilities included:
Overseeing strategic technical planning for the OpsCenter, ensuring alignment with evolving requirements.
Establishing comprehensive documentation standards.
Maintaining and enhancing OpsCenter, which addressed technical issues across the catalog games and services.
Executing sprint tasks, conducting technical research, prototyping, and implementing solutions.
Utilizing Jenkins for CI/CD, Terraform for infrastructure as code, and GCP for scalable cloud solutions.
Leading efforts to develop and improve software architecture while mentoring engineers on technical best practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Software Developer on the Registrations team at Carvana, I facilitated key technical initiatives, including leading the design and development of the Carvana Registration Vendor Integration System (CARVIS) and Notarize as a Service (NaaS). These projects significantly advanced the company’s registration services and notarization capabilities, affecting operations company-wide.

Key responsibilities included:
Designing, leading, and developing CARVIS using C#, Entity Framework, and Kubernetes to create scalable, maintainable architectures for vendor integrations.
Designing, leading, and developing NaaS to provide company-wide notarization capabilities, with a focus on robustness and user experience.
Developing BPMN Automation and GraphQL integrations to align business processes with the broader customer journey.
Ensuring exceptional code quality and system reliability through comprehensive testing, achieving 100% code coverage across all services and maintaining 95% or higher on new code.
Managing source control with VSTS to maintain codebase integrity.

positions.title: Software Developer Consultant
positions.description:
As a Software Developer at ADOT, I initially contributed to the registration team before taking the initiative to lead the ETL effort to migrate the mainframe database to SQL.

Key responsibilities included:
Contributing to the registration API team.
Leading a project to automate an ETL process, successfully migrating all of ADOT’s data from Mainframe systems to a modern SQL schema.
Staying two months beyond the contract to ensure ADOT was ready for the production launch of the Motor Vehicle Modernization project.
Reducing execution time from weeks of manual labor to a 5-hour process, and generating reports of invalid data for corrections.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Developer at Epiq Global, I was a vital member of a new Scrum team, focused on developing and integrating internal tools and services to facilitate the merger between DTI and Epiq. I collaborated closely with Business Analysts to translate product ideas into functional solutions.

Key responsibilities included:
Implementing CI/CD processes using Git, VSTS, and Octopus to streamline the development workflow.
Designing and building backend services using C#, SQL, and Service Fabric to support core features
Developing an automated integration testing framework and crafting a reusable template for subsequent products.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
As a Software Developer and Contractor at inXsol, I managed a broad array of tasks, including product development, team management, quality control, research and development, and functional prototyping. I played a key role in gathering client requirements and delivering tailored product demonstrations to meet their specific needs.

Key responsibilities and contributions included:
Leading the development of simulations, a questionnaire engine, and a variety of e-learning products for edutainment, technical training, and training for first responders.
Overseeing product development from inception to delivery, ensuring high-quality control and effective teamwork.
Delivering functional prototypes that shaped the product development roadmap by refining client requirements.
Contributing to the ongoing enhancement of the custom Learning Management System (LMS), providing market alternatives to off-the-shelf products.
